full_name: Lauren Groff | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Fiction & Poetry Suzanne Young Murray Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Lauren Groff is a writer of critically acclaimed literary fiction, including three novels and two short-story collections. Her most recent book is Florida (Riverhead Books, 2018), a collection of short fiction.
